finalText: Migration's done. 12 files still had the old positional `db.query(sql, params)` calls — all switched to `db.execute({ sql, params })`, and `lib/db.js`'s repo verifier confirms it: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` was left untouched (it's vendored and gets overwritten on upgrade anyway), and the unrelated `cache.query` calls weren't touched either.
